description: As a dispatcher, I want to create a draft aircraft registration so that I can save progress before submitting. All fields are optional for draft submissions — the system auto-saves every 30 seconds and allows partial data.

acs.text: The Registration Number field is mandatory and must be filled before the draft can be saved.
The Aircraft Type field is mandatory and must be validated against the approved type list before saving.
When the user clicks 'Save Draft', the form is saved with the current data.
A confirmation message 'Draft saved successfully' is displayed after each save.
